name: Clinic
brief:
Service: Clinic. A clinic where patients book appointments.

Data:
- Slot: id (text), start (date and time), doctor (text)
- Appointment: id (text), slot (a Slot), patient (text)

Actions:
- findSlots(day: date) returns a list of Slot. Only reads.
- book(slot: Slot, patient: text) returns an Appointment. Changes data. Can be undone with cancel.
- cancel(appointment: Appointment) returns nothing. Changes data. Cannot be undone.

Use exactly these action, parameter, type, and field names.
